GSV Work:
  - Make month variables easier to work with
  - Pivot Longer
  - Convert B3 to B4
  - Remove 2 month visits
```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
mutate(GSV_copy, redcap_event_name = as.factor(redcap_event_name))

table(GSV_copy$redcap_event_name)

GSV_copy <- GSV_copy %>%
  mutate(redcap_event_name = case_when(redcap_event_name == "2_month_visit_arm_1" ~ 2,
                                 redcap_event_name == "6_month_visit_arm_1" ~ 6,
                                 redcap_event_name == "12_month_visit_arm_1" ~ 12,
                                 redcap_event_name == "24_month_visit_arm_1" ~ 24,
                                 redcap_event_name == "36_month_visit_arm_1" ~ 36))

table(GSV_copy$redcap_event_name)

GSV_copy <- pivot_longer(GSV_copy,
                         cols = starts_with("bsid_gsv"),
                         names_to = "category",
                         values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(category = case_when(category == "bsid_gsv_cog" ~ "Cognitive", 
                              category == "bsid_gsv_ec" ~ "Expressive", 
                              category == "bsid_gsv_rc" ~ "Receptive", 
                              category == "bsid_gsv_gm" ~ "Gross Motor", 
                              category == "bsid_gsv_fm" ~ "Fine Motor"))

GSV_copy <- GSV_copy %>%
  mutate(z_score = (score - 500) / 100) %>%
  mutate(bayley4score = round((z_score * 25) + 500))

GSV_copy <- filter(GSV_copy, redcap_event_name != 2)

table(GSV_copy$redcap_event_name)
```

```{r}

set.seed(123)

ggplot(GSV_copy, aes(y = score, x = bsid_age_calc, color = sca_condition))+
  geom_jitter(width = 1.5, height = 0, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Month Visit",
    y = "GSV Score",
    color = "SCA Condition",
    title = "Scores Over Time by SCA Condition and Category") +
  facet_wrap(~ category)

ggplot(GSV_copy, aes(y = score, x = bsid_age_calc, color = sca_condition))+
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Month Visit",
    y = "GSV Score",
    color = "SCA Condition",
    title = "Scores Over Time by SCA Condition and Category") +
  facet_wrap(~ category)

ggplot(GSV_copy, aes(y = score, x = as.factor(redcap_event_name)))+
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(y = "GSV Score",
    x = "Month Visit",
    title = "Scores by Month and Category") +
  facet_wrap(~ category)

```

```{r}
Scaled_copy <- mutate(Scaled_copy, redcap_event_name = as.factor(redcap_event_name))

  mutate(redcap_event_name = case_when(redcap_event_name == "2_month_visit_arm_1" ~ 2,
                                 redcap_event_name == "6_month_visit_arm_1" ~ 6,
                                 redcap_event_name == "18_month_visit_arm_1" ~ 18,
                                 redcap_event_name == "12_month_visit_arm_1" ~ 12,

table(Scaled_copy$redcap_event_name)

Scaled_copy <- pivot_longer(Scaled_copy,
                         cols = ends_with("scaled"),
                         names_to = "category",
                         values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(category = case_when(category == "bsid_cog_scaled" ~ "Cognitive",
```
